mysticalcustomization: Custom Mystical Agriculture crops read from JSON in config/mysticalcustomization/crops
Grows the Luminous Ingot: a supremium seed that costs four ingots and four supremium essence, so the first ingot still needs the six Luminosities

notes.purpose: The pinned Mystical Agriculture 8.0.27 declares its 141 crops in Java (ModCrops) and reads no crop JSON or datapack; only its plugin API (IMysticalAgriculturePlugin) can add crops. Mystical Customization, by the same author, is that plugin: CropLoader reads config/mysticalcustomization/crops/*.json and registers each file as a Crop. It adds no blocks or items of its own.
notes.source: Read-only ATM10 8.1 reference instance at E:/curseforge/Instances/All the Mods 10 - ATM10; CurseForge SHA-1 483c44e51b8f4c8dd24c239f945a819da766d219 matched (project 280441, file 7666340). MIT, JAR 49,374 bytes. No reference-pack configuration is included.
notes.dependencyClosure: No new library: Cucumber 8.0.16 and Mystical Agriculture 8.0.27 are already pinned.
notes.approval: Approved by Elias through the coordinator on 30 September 2026: the native way to fulfil the request for luminous ingot seeds (same author as Mystical Agriculture, MIT, shipped by ATM10).
